While profits have grown at an impressive 32.6% annual rate over five years, this year’s results received a boost from a non-recurring $679 million gain. content.title: Southern California Edison Launches Wildfire Fund
content.summary: While state and local fire officials have not confirmed the cause of the blaze, SCE says it is “likely” that its equipment could be found to be associated with the ignition.  Pedro Pizarro, CEO of Edison International, the parent company of SCE, said in an interview that the company is investigating in tandem with plaintiffs' attorneys and others.  “That hopefully is providing full transparency and confidence that we're doing this the right way and not doing something that could inadvertently damage evidence or something like that," Pizarro said.
